review: The hymn is the resurrection: 1:1–4 is 1 Cor 15:17–20 with Isa 53:6 and Col 2:14, the chorus is 1 Cor 15:55–57 with Rom 8:1, 2:1–4 is Isa 53:5–6 with Rom 3:26, and 3:1–4 is Matt 28:2–3 with 2 Tim 1:10 and Col 2:15.
The chorus repeats 'Christ is risen' at its first line and its last, as the print repeats قَامَ الْمَسِيحُ; the payload keeps both, so the acclamation frames the stanza.

1:4 בּוֹ הַחוֹבוֹת כֻּלָּם שֻׁלָּמוּ — the Arabic بِهِ الدُّيُونُ قَدْ وُفِّيَتْ is 'by Him the debts were paid in full'; the Hebrew uses שִׁלֵּם, the verb of Exod 21:34 and Ps 37:21, and the plural חוֹבוֹת (the Aramaic-style plural of חוֹב), since the stanza is a reckoning and not a release.
